sources.frequency_ghz,core_counts,capacity,buffe: CANN 9.2.1 aarch64-linux/data/platform_config/Ascend950DT_9582.ini, SHA256 b8e7d61780056889e795639504530ecacb2b759ad1602e929b863d837fdf0099. Capacity in decimal GB computed from memory_size bytes.
sources.cube_tops,vector_tops: Huawei 950 NPU architecture white paper table 3-1, matched by core count. Cube 16=BF16/FP16, 8=FP8/INT8, 4=MXFP4. Vector 32=FP32, 16=FP16/BF16, 8=INT8. Unquoted formats are unknown (null). TF32 is distinct from strict FP32.
sources.hbm_bandwidth_gbs: DT family peak, white paper table 3-1, GB/s decimal.
sources.details.rms_output_retained_fraction: Scenario assumption. Dirty RMS outputs may remain in available L2 at kernel retirement. No direct writeback counter. Use 0 for forced external drain; 1 is capped by target spare L2 after active input buffers.
sources.details.quant_*: v0.19 stage calibration from archived Ascend950DT_9582 official CA. Earliest payload issue conditioned on single tile vs pipelined, response cycles and SIMD entry/exit clocks. quant_loop_work_ops is the common DT stage slope converted to peak-equivalent operations. These prices also include simulator dispatch behaviour.

sources.scope: User-provided prospective architecture scenario, one scheduling domain. All 970DT timings are extrapolations; no target CA or measurements used.
sources.cube_tops: User scenario: dense 4-bit 14160 TOP/s with 16:8:4-bit ratio 1:2:8. Strict FP32 unspecified. Availability of a kernel for a given dtype is a separate contract.
sources.cube_cores,vector_cores,frequency_ghz: User scenario: 120 AIC and 120 AIV at 1.8 GHz.
sources.vector_tops.16: Assumed unchanged 950 vector datapath. 120 cores * 1.8 GHz * 128 scalar MAC per issue * 2 issues/cycle * 2 ops/MAC = 110.592 TFLOP/s. Dual issue is counted once.
sources.vector_tops.32,vector_tops.8: Assume the DT FP32:FP16:INT8 vector peak ratios 1:2:2 carry over. The 8-bit field represents INT8, not evidence for FP8 vector arithmetic.
sources.hbm_capacity_gb,hbm_bandwidth_gbs,detail: User scenario: 288 decimal GB, 14.4 decimal TB/s; 200 decimal MB and 30 decimal TB/s aggregate L2 bandwidth.
sources.details.ub_bytes,details.l1_bytes,detail: Unspecified per-core capacities inherit 950DT from the chip loader (UB 248 KiB).
sources.mte: Unspecified MTE1/2/3 use the applicable resource model's 950 effective per-core bytes/cycle and latency/issue defaults. Shared L2 and off-chip limits come from this config. Other operators retain the documented DT phase projection.
sources.details.fa_aiv_per_aic: FA implementation scenario: at most one vector worker per active Cube worker. Hardware core counts alone do not establish kernel binding. Set to 2 for pooled workers.

sources.details.matmul_initial_read_gbs: Observed lower bound on logical GM read service, GB/s, from separate 950PR Cast/Sigmoid CA windows (matmul_supply parameter set). Used only for capacity-bounded initial operand read credit. Includes cache service; physical HBM bandwidth is configured separately.
sources.frequency_ghz,core_counts,capacity,buffe: CANN 9.2.1 aarch64-linux/data/platform_config/Ascend950PR_957b.ini, SHA256 afa39753ab256048cc190060b1fcc8ed73c5b086f93563f2a73560a2870a8da0. Capacity in decimal GB computed from memory_size bytes.
sources.cube_tops,vector_tops: Huawei 950 NPU architecture white paper table 3-1, matched by core count. Cube 16=BF16/FP16, 8=FP8/INT8, 4=MXFP4. Vector 32=FP32, 16=FP16/BF16, 8=INT8. Unquoted formats are unknown (null). TF32 is distinct from strict FP32.
sources.hbm_bandwidth_gbs: PR 112 GiB SKU tier inferred from package memory_size and spec table; bandwidth not independently measured, white paper table 3-1, GB/s decimal.
sources.details.quant_*: v0.19 stage calibration from archived Ascend950PR_957b official CA. Earliest payload issue conditioned on single tile vs pipelined, response cycles and SIMD entry/exit clocks. quant_loop_work_ops is the common DT stage slope converted to peak-equivalent operations. These prices also include simulator dispatch behaviour.
v0.19 paired RMSNorm isolated first launches in CANN 9.2.1. Seven archived v0.17/v0.18 DT/PR same-partition, identical-binary shapes. Median PR minus DT relative to DT phase price: exclusive terminal-AIV SCALAR -353 cycles; earliest input DMA issue -194 cycles at 1.65 GHz. Simulator and kernel dependent; no PR whole-window fit.
